### 1 — Scene
This looks most like a **split baked potato topped with chopped tomato-onion salsa and green salsa**, with a small amount of a white topping, possibly sour cream. The identification is somewhat uncertain from the photo.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The area shares below partition the food-covered footprint; overlapping toppings are assigned their own share rather than counted twice.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baked potato, including browned skin | 30% | 159 | 1.7 | 270 | 0.9 | 243 | 93 | 226 |
| Chopped tomato, onion, and herbs | 15% | 80 | 0.8 | 64 | 0.6 | 38 | 30 | 11 |
| Green salsa | 7% | 37 | 0.4 | 15 | 1.0 | 15 | 35 | 5 |
| White creamy topping, assumed sour cream | 3% | 16 | 0.6 | 10 | 1.0 | 10 | 200 | 20 |
| **Total** | **55%** | **292** | | **359** | | **306** | | **262** |

### 8 — Sanity check
About **305 g and 260 kcal** is plausible for a moderately sized baked potato with moist vegetable toppings covering roughly half the plate. No separate oil or butter is clearly visible, so none is added. The main uncertainty is whether the white portions are entirely potato or include a creamy topping.
